section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants for Study X, which included 249 college women from a regional campus of a large Midwestern U.S. university, ranging in age from 18 to 28 (M = 19.1). The majority of participants identified as White/Caucasian (86.3%), with most being first-year students (77.1%), and all participants had college or higher education experience. Demographic information on relationship status and socioeconomic identification is also provided.
